title: Larger root of a single-modulus linear equation
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.1 Quick check 1 (|2x-5|=9, larger root 7)

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: \({a|int}x-{b|int}={c|int}\) or \({a|int}x-{b|int}=-{c|int}\), so the roots are \(\dfrac{{b|int}+{c|int}}{{a|int}}\) and \(\dfrac{{b|int}-{c|int}}{{a|int}}\).
steps.note: Drop the modulus to obtain a pair of linear equations.

steps.name: E
steps.note: Larger root, since a is positive.

contexts.stem: Find the larger solution of the equation \(\lvert {a|int}x-{b|int}\rvert={c|int}\).
contexts.note: worded as find the larger solution

title: Sum of the two roots of an equation with a modulus on each side
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.1 Quick check 2 (|3x+1|=|x-5|, sum of roots -2)
stem: Solve \(\lvert {a|int}x+{p|int}\rvert=\lvert x-{q|int}\rvert\). Give the sum of the two roots.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: \({a|int}x+{p|int}=x-{q|int}\) gives one root, and \({a|int}x+{p|int}=-(x-{q|int})\) gives the other. Both roots satisfy the original equation because each side is a modulus.
steps.note: A pair of linear equations, or the equivalent difference of squares.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The sum of the roots is \(\dfrac{-({p|int}+{q|int})}{{a|int}-1}+\dfrac{{q|int}-{p|int}}{{a|int}+1}\).

contexts.stem: Solve \(\lvert {a|int}u+{p|int}\rvert=\lvert u-{q|int}\rvert\). Give the sum of the two roots.
Find the sum of the solutions of \(\lvert {a|int}x+{p|int}\rvert=\lvert x-{q|int}\rvert\).

title: The only valid root of a modulus equal to a linear expression
source: P23 Ch1 theory P23-1.1 Quick check 3 (|x-4|=3x-2, only valid root 3/2)
stem: Solve \(\lvert x-{b|int}\rvert={c|int}x-{d|int}\). Give the only valid root.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The candidates come from \(x-{b|int}={c|int}x-{d|int}\) and from \(x-{b|int}=-({c|int}x-{d|int})\).
steps.note: Drop the modulus to obtain two linear equations.

steps.name: check
steps.text_tex: The first candidate must be rejected: the right-hand side is negative there, but a modulus is never negative.
steps.note: Reject the invalid candidate by checking the original equation.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The remaining root is \(\dfrac{{b|int}+{d|int}}{{c|int}+1}\), and it satisfies the original equation.

contexts.stem: Solve \(\lvert u-{b|int}\rvert={c|int}u-{d|int}\). Give the only valid root.
Find the only solution of \(\lvert x-{b|int}\rvert={c|int}x-{d|int}\).
contexts.note: worded as find the only solution
